newsitem.title: GERMANY: German producer prices flat in February.
newsitem.headline: German producer prices flat in February.

text.p: German producer prices were unchanged in February, and up 0.6 percent against the same month a year earlier, the Federal Statistics Office said on Friday.
Prices were steady following a 0.3 percent rise in January, when the producer price index rose by 0.7 percent year-on-year.

Producer prices in western Germany were in line with the national figure. In eastern Germany, they were also unchanged in February compared with January, but were up by 1.7 percent compared with a year-earlier period.
Main price changes in February were in non-ferrous metals, which rose by 3.8 percent, oil products (-2.4 percent) and for extruded and cold-rolled steel products (-2.1 percent).
